## Overview

Fixes #62793. Align adaptive-verification draft-prefill CUDA graphs with the target's shared attention metadata, including when another data-parallel rank is prefilling.

## Claims

- Capture varlen draft-prefill graphs under AV and exclude prefill-bearing batches from decode-only graphs.
- Preserve the agreed `max_query_len` in `DPSyncState` and reuse it, including `None`, without another collective.
- Extend the existing regression with DP > 1 peer-prefill and longer-peer-decode cases.

## Validation

Rebased onto upstream main `5d35ce3934a7804b298559d2d99eec33792e1eb9`. Local checks on macOS:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/v1/cudagraph \
  tests/v1/cudagraph/test_cudagraph_manager.py \
  -k 'not test_full_capture_sets_graph_pool_id_before_cuda_graph' -q
```

**29 passed, 1 deselected.** The excluded pre-existing capture test requires a current stream unavailable on this host; CI runs the complete file.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/v1/worker \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py \
  -k 'test_every_dp_rank_must_agree_to_microbatch or test_decode_threshold_only_applies_when_every_rank_is_a_uniform_decode or test_microbatching_pads_all_ranks_to_the_largest or test_microbatching_survives_a_rank_that_cannot_fill_it or test_microbatching_off_when_a_rank_does_not_allow_it' -q
```

**5 passed, 25 deselected.** Applicable pre-commit hooks, including Ruff, mypy and CI test tethering, and `git diff --check` passed.

The existing **CPU V1 Others** (`v1-others-cpu`) Buildkite job already runs `test_cudagraph_manager.py` and depends on `vllm/v1/` and `tests/v1`. No CI configuration changes are needed. [Buildkite CI #97530](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/97530) is running for `94fcf82c7f83`. Pre-commit and docs passed; `v1-others-cpu`, which includes the added DP regressions, has not completed yet.

`CPU-Spec Decode Tests` soft-failed on the existing `test_dflash_fc_runs_fp32_target_hidden_states_in_draft_dtype`: `ReplicatedLinear` has no `cpu_linear`. The exact upstream base `5d35ce39` has the [same failure in main CI #97527](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/97527#01a17bf7-46e5-4f1f-bc9e-95f8e3cd8d54), also with 1 failed, 111 passed and 121 skipped. The affected test/model/linear files are unchanged by this PR. The same failure was independently reproduced on both the PR head and a clean base worktree with `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu` and the isolated pytest node. The test omits CPU linear post-load initialization; this unrelated baseline failure is left outside this PR.

<details>
<summary>DP regression before and after the fix</summary>

Before rebasing, the extended regression was run with production files from the previous PR head `b3ae85bbec7eb348130f4a2e18a71b1bfcbca06c`:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/v1/cudagraph \
  tests/v1/cudagraph/test_cudagraph_manager.py \
  -k draft_prefill_matches_shared_target_metadata_shape -q
```

Before: **2 failed, 5 passed, 23 deselected**. The peer-prefill case selects draft FULL versus target PIECEWISE; the longer-peer-decode case exposes the missing synchronized-bound field. With the fix: **7 passed, 23 deselected**.

These are CPU dispatch regressions with a simulated external collective, not real multi-GPU inference results. The rebased suite also passes, as reported above.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Earlier single-GPU model validation</summary>

The equivalent candidate-source fix was validated on v0.31.0, H100 NVL, Qwen3-32B W4A16 + Eagle3, K=3, FA3, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, concurrency 4. Across two independent starts with 10s warmup and 30s measurement, mean output throughput was 352.4 tok/s unpatched versus 684.0 tok/s with the candidate; mean acceptance lengths were 1.425 and 2.906. Both candidate runs had zero request errors and matched a fixed-K greedy smoke on four prompts. The isolated FA3 reproducer in #62793 failed with mismatched padding and passed with aligned padding.

Those results are from v0.31.0, not this rebased checkout or the DP follow-up. The instance was destroyed. No current multi-GPU validation or AV trimming speedup is claimed.

</details>

## Details

Draft prefill shares the target's attention metadata and must use the same padded request layout. With DP, another rank's prefill makes the agreed query bound `None`; reusing a local decode bound can incorrectly select FULL after the target selected PIECEWISE. All state-construction paths now preserve the agreed bound, while uniform draft batches reset it to their own query length. The upstream benchmark's eager state is updated for the new field.

Duplicate checks were refreshed: #62953 handles final redispatch disagreement between rank-local graph inventories; #63523 optimizes CPU metadata math. Neither implements this target-to-draft bound reuse fix. No other open PR was found linked to #62793.

AI assistance was used for diagnosis, implementation, tests, review and validation.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Local CPU regressions pass and existing CI covers the file; rebased CI is pending. Current multi-GPU validation is not claimed.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

I missed a DP > 1 case in my first review. The draft prefill reuses the target's `DPSyncState` to skip the collective, but `DPSyncState` doesn't carry `max_query_len`, so the reuse path dispatches with the draft's local bound instead of the one agreed across ranks.

Can you please track `max_query_len` in `DPSyncState`, and reuse it during `dispatch_cg_and_sync_dp`? Also please add a test for the DP > 1 case if possible!
LGTM, but plz make sure to drop the docs change

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

I missed a DP > 1 case in my first review. The draft prefill reuses the target's `DPSyncState` to skip the collective, but `DPSyncState` doesn't carry `max_query_len`, so the reuse path dispatches with the draft's local bound instead of the one agreed across ranks.

Can you please track `max_query_len` in `DPSyncState`, and reuse it during `dispatch_cg_and_sync_dp`? Also please add a test for the DP > 1 case if possible!
LGTM, but plz make sure to drop the docs change
